title: Nutrient Deplete/Replete Algal Culture for Elemental Analysis
author: Amy Zimmerman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gukbwuw

steps.title: Prepare and Grow Experimental Culture
steps.instruction: Initiate an experimental culture and maintain it for at least 7 generations (10 generations preferred) of characterized exponential growth prior to centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Monitor growth daily and perform transfers/dilutions to a pre-determined mid-exponential density (semi-continuous culture) until target biomass is reached.
Maintain cell density within the exponential range by increasing culture volume rather than cell density when ramping up to target biomass.

For Ostreococcus lucimarinus (CCMP2972A), use growth conditions: 18°C, 14:10 hour light:dark cycle, light irradiance ~100 µE m-2 s-1, and L1 medium with natural seawater base (exponential range: 7x10^5 – 2x10^7 cells/mL).

steps.title: Concentrate and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Concentrate the target biomass using a centrifuge and wash the cells with nutrient-deplete medium.

substeps.instruction: Split the culture volume evenly among 2 or 4 acid-cleaned and autoclaved centrifuge bottles.
Balance bottles by removing volume until pairs are within 0.01 g of each other.
Open bottles only in a hood to maintain axenicity.
Load bottles into a Sorvall RC 26 Plus centrifuge with a large rotor (GS-3, option code '03'), ensuring pins are offset and paired bottles are opposite each other.
Spin at 7300 RPM (10,000 rcf) for 32 minutes (including 2 minute ramp up) at +20/+25°C.
Transport bottles back to the hood without resuspending cell pellets/smears.
Gently pour off supernatant into a waste container.
Resuspend/wash cells with a volume of nutrient-deplete medium equivalent to the initial culture volume in each bottle; repeat this wash 2-8 times.
Perform a final resuspension with nutrient-deplete medium at ~5% of the initial culture volume per bottle.
Determine cell density using an Accuri flow cytometer, storing cells at normal growth conditions during the run and calculations.

steps.title: Initiate Experimental Nutrient Cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate nutrient-replete and nutrient-deplete culture flasks using the cell concentrate.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the volume of concentrate needed based on Accuri measurements to achieve a starting density corresponding to early-exponential growth.
Adjust pre-aliquoted media in experimental flasks as needed to reach target density and volume.
Mix and sample cultures daily using FCM and Accuri to monitor growth.
Collect samples for FCM and elemental analyses once the average daily growth rate of nutrient-deplete cultures (GR DEP) is half or less of the replete cultures (GR DEP / GR REP < 0.5).

steps.title: Collect Flow Cytometry (FCM) Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare culture samples for cell counting via FCM.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of culture to a sterile 1.2 mL cryovial tube.
Add 10 µL 25% glutaraldehyde (0.25% final concentration) and gently vortex to mix.
Aliquot 500 µL into a duplicate cryovial.
Snap cryovials into cryocanes and incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes in the dark.
Flash freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Collect Elemental Analysis (EA) Samples
steps.instruction: Filter culture to collect particulate and dissolved nutrients.

substeps.instruction: Set up an acid-cleaned and autoclaved glass filter unit with a pre-combusted 25mm Advantec glass fiber filter.
Using ethanol-cleaned forceps in a hood, apply 20-40 mL of media or culture to the filter funnel and apply vacuum until dry.
Use ethanol-cleaned forceps to fold the filter in half and collect it in a 12-well plate or on combusted aluminum foil.
Pour the filtrate into an acid-cleaned 50 mL conical tube.
Repeat the process for sample duplicates, rinsing the filter tower with MilliQ between samples.
Store filters and filtrate at -20°C.

steps.title: Collect DAPI Samples for Microscopy
steps.instruction: Fix culture samples to assess axenicity via DAPI staining.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of culture to a sterile 1.2 mL cryovial tube.
In the chemical hood, add 100 µL of 37% formaldehyde (3.7% final concentration) and mix by inverting (do not vortex).
Snap cryovials into cryocanes and incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes.
Store at 4°C, or flash freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Process Samples for Analysis
steps.instruction: Ship elemental analysis samples to Analytical Services at Horn Point Laboratory (UMCES).
